title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Automatic Transfers That Rebuild Overdraft Protection Balances
content:
A Savings & Money Market Accounts product that backs a checking account as its overdraft protection source gives up money whenever it covers a shortfall. This page is the entry point for an owner who wants a monthly automatic transfer sized to make good both the overdraft protection draws on the account during a statement cycle and the withdrawal charges the account is left carrying for it.

## What the policy governs

- **Request.** A monthly automatic transfer from checking whose amount restores the overdraft protection outflow of a cycle and the withdrawal fees the account carries for it.
- **Result.** The monthly amount of the instruction.
- **Everything else unchanged.** Which checking account funds it, which day of the month (1 to 28) it runs on, and every other feature of the instruction follow the ordinary automatic transfer rules, exactly as for any other automatic transfer.

## Setting up the instruction

The instruction is the owner's own. The agent unlocks `set_savings_automatic_transfer_e1e909eb` by way of `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, so that the customer themselves can submit it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** One submission records the standing instruction on the savings or money market account: a fixed monthly sum, the day of the month on which it runs and the checking account it is drawn from, overwriting any earlier instruction. The first run happens on the next occurrence of that day. The savings account lookup afterwards shows the new sum, day and funding checking account.

## Parameters

- `savings_account_id`: identifier of the savings or money market account that receives the transfers, from the savings account lookup.
- `funding_checking_account_id`: identifier of the owner's own checking account the transfers are drawn from, from the checking account lookup.
- `automatic_transfer_amount`: the fixed monthly sum, US dollars, positive, two decimal places.
- `automatic_transfer_day`: the day of the month on which the transfer runs, a whole number from 1 to 28, passed as an integer.

## Receipt

The reply is a dictionary rendered as text containing `savings_account_id`, `automatic_transfer_amount` (two decimals), `automatic_transfer_day` (1 to 28) and `funding_checking_account_id`. A reply that repeats the requested sum and day shows the instruction is recorded.

## Quick answers

**Who submits the instruction?** The owner does. The agent's part is to unlock the tool and hand it over.
